text: a driver MUST move out of the lane closest to the stopped vehicle WHEN an emergency medical vehicle, law enforcement vehicle, fire truck, tow truck, utility service vehicle, Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) vehicle or other highway construction or maintenance vehicle is stopped on the road with its lights on or flashing AND the road has multiple lanes traveling in the same direction UNLESS the driver slows down to 20 mph below the speed limit

text: a driver MUST yield the right-of-way to a school bus

a driver MUST stop WHEN the driver is approaching a school bus from either direction AND the school bus is displaying alternately flashing red lights IF VIOLATED a fine of $500 to $1,250 for a first conviction AND a fine of $1,000 to $2,000 AND a [?possible] licence suspension of up to 6 months for a second or later conviction within 5 years
note: The penalties are Table 17 (p15–p16), which p14 applies to failing to yield to school buses displaying flashing lights; the diagram (p9) shows traffic stopped in both directions.

strength_from: context (Mandatory Suspension: "Overtaking and passing a school bus"; Table 17: "passing a stopped school bus")
text: a driver MUST NOT pass a school bus WHEN the school bus is displaying alternately flashing red lights UNTIL the school bus has resumed motion OR the school bus driver signals the driver to proceed OR the red lights are no longer flashing IF VIOLATED a fine of $500 to $1,250 for a first conviction AND a fine of $1,000 to $2,000 AND a [?possible] licence suspension of up to 6 months for a second or later conviction within 5 years AND an automatic licence suspension for a subsequent conviction AND a Class A misdemeanor punishable by a fine of up to $4,000 and/or up to 1 year in jail if the driver causes serious bodily injury to another person when passing a stopped school bus AND a state jail felony punishable by 180 days to 2 years confinement and a [?possible] fine of up to $10,000 if the driver causes serious bodily injury and has previously been convicted of passing a school bus and causing serious bodily injury

text: TO pass a truck

text: a truck driver SHOULD stay to the far side of the lane WHEN another vehicle is passing the truck BECAUSE this makes the pass easier for the passing driver

text: FACT a truck driver who flashes the truck's lights after being passed signals that it is clear for the passing driver to move back in front of the truck

strength_from: imperative ("help the truck driver by keeping to the far side")

a driver SHOULD NOT cross behind a truck WHEN the truck is preparing to back up

strength_from: imperative ("Wait for the truck to complete its maneuver")

a driver SHOULD NOT cut in front of a truck

text: FACT cutting into the open space in front of a truck or bus removes the truck or bus driver's cushion of safety

strength_from: imperative ("Either slow down and exit or stay behind the truck")
